description: Find upcoming events — the tool for planning an outing. Compose filters freely: a date range (`from`/`to`), free text (`q`, accent-insensitive: "musica" finds "Música"), `category`, a price ceiling (`price_max`), and a point plus radius (`near_lat`/`near_lng`/`radius_km` — e.g. the coordinates of a place from get_place, or of the user). All filters are applied to the WHOLE calendar before paging, never to a first slice. Results are chronological by next occurrence; page with `offset` while `hasMore` is true. Each event carries numeric `price` ({min, max, currency, isFree, known} — `known: false` means the source publishes no price, not that it is free), `lat`/`lng`, and `purchase` ({mode, tool, url, platform}) telling you HOW to attend: `reserve` → reserve_event_tickets; `rsvp` → rsvp_event; `external` → only a human can buy, at `url`; `free` → just go. Events within the next 7 days include a weatherForecast. On a city-wide agenda, the first page lists `availableCategories`. Use get_event for the full description, line-up and ticket types of one event. Omit `from`/`to` to see every upcoming event — don't guess date windows to find one event. When filters match nothing, the response carries a `hint` with the closest events outside them.

category.description: Event category, by label or slug (case- and accent-insensitive). On a city-wide agenda an unknown category returns the valid list.

filter.description: Shortcut presets: "agora" = on stage at this exact moment (season runs and day-granular sources are excluded, because their stored window says nothing about whether a session is on right now); "hoje"/"amanha"/"fim-de-semana" = running on those days, including multi-day runs; "gratis" = free to attend, including externally-ticketed events priced at 0. Date presets cannot be combined with from/to; "gratis" can.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the site's local time zone (returned as `timeZone`). Defaults to today; past days are clamped to today.

include_unknown_price.description: With price_max: also return events whose price is not published (check them at `purchase.url`). Default false.

near_lat.description: Latitude of the point to search around. Requires near_lng. Events without coordinates and online events are excluded.

near_lng.description: Longitude of the point to search around. Requires near_lat.

offset.description: Skip this many matches — pass the previous response's `nextOffset`. Max 500.

price_max.description: Max price of the cheapest ticket, in the event's currency. Free events always pass; events with no published price are excluded unless include_unknown_price is true.

q.description: Free text — every word must appear in the title, venue or description. Accent-insensitive.

radius_km.description: Radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 3, max 50). Each result then carries `distanceKm`.

sort.description: "date" (default) = chronological by next occurrence; "distance" = nearest first (needs near_lat/near_lng).

to.description: Last day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to `from` (a single day). Max range 62 days. Multi-day runs that overlap the range are included.

upcoming_only.description: Only return upcoming or in-progress events (default true).

name: list_events
